dedupe_keys.name: fundamental properties of floor mounted nonstructural component in hospitals

description: Fundamental Properties of Floor-Mounted Nonstructural Component in Hospitals is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Tara Hutchinson, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This project aggregated fundamental properties of nonstructural components NCs from components tested using the AC156 seismic qualification tests for the California Department of Health Care Access and Information. Further studies on the relation between different properties may be inferred or specific characteristics of specific classes of NCs can be found. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: nonstructural components. Published 2024-06-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
